finalCrossCheck: Major emergency-medicine RCT cross-check: all 116 distinct cached metadata candidates were screened; no ED RCT beyond the selected general-journal tetanus phase 3 trial met the practice-impact threshold.

Major NEJM/JAMA/Lancet/BMJ acute-care cross-check: the sole general-journal candidate, the Nature Medicine siltartoxatug phase 3 trial, was primary-verified and selected as Watch List because its endpoint was serologic and US availability was not established.
ACEP clinical-policy cross-check: targeted official search did not verify a new July 6-12, 2025 ACEP clinical policy; exhaustive dated archive coverage was not certified.
AHA/ASA guidance cross-check: targeted official search did not identify a new major in-window statement; complete archive chronology was not certified.
SCCM/sepsis cross-check: targeted official search did not identify a new July 6-12 SCCM or sepsis guideline; the cached early-fluid meta-analysis was not considered practice-changing on its own.
IDSA cross-check: the new complicated-UTI guidance surfaced with a July 17, 2025 date, outside this window; no separate in-window IDSA guidance was verified.
CHEST cross-check: no new July 6-12 major CHEST guideline was verified; an acute-brain-injury ventilation observational study remains below the selection threshold pending fuller appraisal.
Hematology/bleeding/anticoagulation cross-check: targeted ASH search did not verify new in-window emergency guidance.
Toxicology cross-check: targeted ACMT/AACT search did not verify a new July 6-12 clinical statement; low-impact toxicology reports were excluded.

Trauma cross-check: a Japanese REBOA consensus candidate and a 2025 EAST hemothorax PMG surfaced but exact primary dating/recommendation appraisal remains unresolved and was queued rather than treated as completed guidance coverage.
Pediatric emergency cross-check: targeted AAP search found no new in-window major emergency guideline; later 2025 resuscitation guidance is outside the window.
Obstetric emergency cross-check: targeted ACOG search did not verify a new July 6-12 emergency guidance document.

Historical/correction cross-check: no correction was verified for the selected pancreatitis, tetanus, AF-screening, or CRP/ESR articles; the AF study has later correspondence emphasizing interpretation limits, and the pancreatitis guideline is international and should be reconciled with US ACG guidance.

excludedCandidates.reason: Extended-release injectable buprenorphine ED initiation report was a small retrospective cohort; useful implementation evidence but not strong enough for this selective batch and later randomized evidence is more definitive.
Meta-analysis of early fluid resuscitation in sepsis did not establish a sufficiently specific new ED treatment change beyond existing individualized-resuscitation guidance.
Peri-intubation cardiac-arrest risk-factor study was observational case-control evidence from a low-resource setting and did not provide a validated intervention likely to change broad ED practice.

Primary PubMed abstract verified Epub July 11, 2025. This multicenter web-based image-interpretation study identified challenging first-trimester POCUS findings and review behaviors, but did not test a patient-management intervention or clinical outcome; excluded under the selective ED-impact threshold.

Primary PubMed abstract verified Epub July 9, 2025. Five-round Delphi consensus of 11 Japanese trauma specialists plus descriptive registry comparisons is locally informative but not a broadly applicable guideline or causal effectiveness study; excluded under the selective threshold.

Primary PubMed abstract/full open-access record verified Epub July 8, 2025. Prospective observational secondary analysis found lower adjusted ICU mortality with tidal volume <=8 mL/kg PBW, but residual confounding, ICU setting, and no ED intervention make it insufficient for a selected historical record.

Official EAST page reviewed 2026-10-29 identifies a workgroup and statement of need but no dated published guideline or recommendations. It is excluded as not an established public in-window guidance record, rather than silently treated as absent.
